fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-09-11, the cousin of the complainant, Tamilarasan Palanisamy, aged 18, left for work and could not be contacted afterwards; last seen near Mangai Puram Railway Station Road. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-09-11 at roughly 21:45. The complainant could not identify the person involved. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. The complaint refers to Sanjay Mani, an intermediary, reachable on 9000000120. Items referenced in the complaint: social media screenshots.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Student reportedly left for college and could not be contacted afterwards.
fields.Keywords: missing person, student, screenshot, associate, railway station road, night
